title: Void Metal Studio – Full Prompt-Based Visual Music Studio

requirements.text: Create the full dark mythical visual theme: cracked black stone background with glowing ember red-orange vein cracks, dragon scale texture patterns, cinematic dark lighting with dramatic shadows, and a massive Gargoyle Dragon face rendered prominently in the upper background area with glowing red eyes staring forward. Apply this theme consistently across all UI surfaces. Use blood-red as the primary accent color for text, borders, and interactive elements. Typography must be heavy gothic style.

quotes: Dark mythical cracked black stone background with glowing ember red-orange cracks and dragon scales. Massive Gargoyle Dragon face looming prominently, glowing eyes staring forward. ForeverRaw energy everywhere – raw, heavy, Southern gothic rock meets dark fantasy, high detail, cinematic lighting, dramatic shadows.

acceptanceCriteria: Background displays cracked black stone texture with glowing red-orange ember vein cracks
Large gargoyle dragon face visible in upper background with glowing red eyes
All text uses blood-red gothic typography
Cinematic shadow and glow effects applied throughout
Dragon scale texture patterns present on UI panels

requirements.text: Build a top toolbar with exactly 5 heavy forged-metal cracked-stone styled buttons with blood-red dragon icons and labels: 'Upload Photo', 'Upload Video', 'Music Gen', 'Video Gen', 'Export'. Below the toolbar, centered, add a separate 'Effects' button with a dragon eye icon. All buttons must have a forged-metal / cracked-stone visual style with blood-red labels.

quotes: Toolbar (top): 5 heavy forged-metal cracked-stone buttons with dragon icons/labels (blood-red): Upload Photo, Upload Video, Music Gen, Video Gen, Export. Effects button: Dropped down below toolbar, centered, with dragon eye icon.

acceptanceCriteria: Toolbar renders at top with exactly 5 buttons: Upload Photo, Upload Video, Music Gen, Video Gen, Export
Each toolbar button has cracked-stone forged-metal styling with blood-red label
Effects button appears below toolbar, horizontally centered, with dragon eye icon
All buttons are interactive and trigger their respective functions

requirements.text: Build the central canvas area: a large cracked black stone panel with glowing fire vein overlay. Display bold blood-red gothic text 'Drop your creation here' when empty. Support drag-and-drop file upload directly onto the canvas for all file types: images (jpg/png/gif/webp), video (mp4/webm), text/lyrics (.txt), audio (mp3/wav). After upload, immediately render a preview: image thumbnail for photos, HTML5 video player for video, audio waveform visualization for audio files, and scrollable text preview for .txt files. Multiple files can be loaded.

quotes: Central Canvas: Large cracked black stone area with glowing fire veins. Bold blood-red gothic text 'Drop your creation here'. Support drag-and-drop or button upload for any file type: Photos, Videos, Text (.txt/lyrics), Audio (mp3/wav), other media. Display previews (image thumbnails, audio waveform, text preview, etc.) after upload.

acceptanceCriteria: Canvas displays cracked stone with fire vein glow effect
Empty state shows 'Drop your creation here' in blood-red gothic text
Drag-and-drop from desktop onto canvas works for all supported file types
Image files show thumbnail preview immediately after drop/upload
Audio files render a waveform visualization
Video files show an embedded video player
Text files show a scrollable preview of content
Upload Photo and Upload Video toolbar buttons open native file picker and load files into canvas

requirements.text: Build the bottom panel with three elements: (1) A large burning stone styled 'IGNITE' button with fire glow animation; (2) A 'Dragon Power' slider labeled with that name, controlling generation intensity (value 0–100, default 75); (3) A status display showing 'AWAITING COMMAND' by default, updating to reflect current action state (e.g., 'GENERATING...', 'COMPLETE', 'ERROR'). All elements must match the dark stone / blood-red aesthetic.

quotes: Bottom Panel: Burning stone 'IGNITE' button. 'Dragon Power' slider (controls generation intensity). 'AWAITING COMMAND' status.

acceptanceCriteria: IGNITE button is prominently displayed with fire glow animation
Dragon Power slider renders with blood-red track and stone handle
Slider value range is 0–100, defaulting to 75
Status text displays 'AWAITING COMMAND' on load
Status text updates dynamically during operations

requirements.text: Implement the Effects button functionality: clicking it opens a dropdown/modal overlay with a menu of dragon-themed visual effects that can be applied to content on the canvas. Include at minimum these effects: Fire Glow, Chain Overlay, Stone Crack, Dragon Breath, Ember Pulse, Shadow Veil, Blood Drip. Each effect is selectable and applies a CSS filter/overlay to the active canvas content preview.

quotes: Effects: Opens a menu with dragon-themed effects (e.g., fire glow, chain overlay, stone crack, etc.).

acceptanceCriteria: Clicking the Effects button opens an effects menu/panel
Menu contains at least 7 named dragon-themed effects
Selecting an effect applies a visual transformation to the canvas content
Effects can be toggled on/off
Menu closes after selection or on outside click

requirements.text: Implement the Music Gen and Video Gen toolbar buttons: each opens a modal prompt asking the user for a text seed/description. On submission, send the seed text and Dragon Power slider value to the Red Hat shepherd-main backend endpoint as a POST request. Display a loading state on the canvas ('GENERATING...' status). On response, render the result in the canvas: audio waveform player for music, video player for video. Log the endpoint connection confirmation to the browser console on each call.

quotes: Music Gen / Video Gen: Prompts user for text/seed, sends to Red Hat backend for generation (use shepherd-main endpoint). Return results in canvas (audio waveform or video preview).
Red Hat Connection: Integrate shepherd-main Red Hat backend endpoint. IGNITE button sends seed to Red Hat AI for content generation. Confirm connection in console.

acceptanceCriteria: Music Gen button opens a text seed input modal
Video Gen button opens a text seed input modal
On submit, POST request is sent to the shepherd-main endpoint with seed and power level
Console logs 'shepherd-main endpoint connected' on each call
Canvas shows 'GENERATING...' status during the request
Music result renders as audio waveform player in canvas
Video result renders as video player in canvas
Status updates to 'COMPLETE' or 'ERROR' after generation

requirements.text: Implement the IGNITE button: on click, collect all uploaded canvas content (files) plus a seed text prompt (prompt user if no text file is loaded), combine with Dragon Power slider value, and send as a POST request to the Red Hat shepherd-main endpoint for AI generation (image, music, or video depending on content type). Display the returned result in the canvas. Log connection confirmation to console.

quotes: IGNITE: Sends the uploaded content + seed text to Red Hat AI for generation (images, music, videos). Return result in canvas.

acceptanceCriteria: IGNITE sends uploaded content metadata and seed text to shepherd-main endpoint
Dragon Power value is included in the request payload
If no text seed is loaded, user is prompted for one before sending
Result is rendered in canvas matching content type
Console confirms shepherd-main connection on each IGNITE call

requirements.text: Implement the Export button: triggers a download of the current canvas content (active image/audio/video) with an invisible user-specific steganographic-style text watermark embedded in the filename and metadata. The watermark must encode the user's identity session ID. Display an export confirmation in the status area.

quotes: Export: Download the final creation with invisible watermark. No stealing allowed.

acceptanceCriteria: Export button triggers a file download of active canvas content
Downloaded filename encodes a user session identifier
Status area confirms 'EXPORT COMPLETE' after download
Export is disabled when canvas is empty

requirements.text: Implement hardcore content protection on all canvas content: (1) Disable right-click context menu over the canvas and any media previews; (2) Block keyboard shortcuts for save (Ctrl+S), copy (Ctrl+C), and print (Ctrl+P); (3) Apply CSS user-select: none and pointer-events blocking where applicable; (4) On any detected violation attempt, display a full-screen ban overlay with the exact message: 'The Dragon caught you stealing. Account permanently removed. Created by Skulls for the people who wanna stay real.' Mark the user's session as permanently banned in the backend. Once banned, all subsequent page loads show only the ban overlay. Note: browser-level screenshot prevention is not technically enforceable; protection is best-effort via JS event blocking.

quotes: Hardcore Protection: Active on all user content (photos, videos, text, audio). Attempt to screenshot, save, download, right-click, or copy content = instant permanent ban. Invisible user-specific watermark on everything. Ban message: 'The Dragon caught you stealing. Account permanently removed. Created by Skulls for the people who wanna stay real.'

acceptanceCriteria: Right-clicking on canvas or media previews is blocked
Ctrl+S, Ctrl+C, Ctrl+P keyboard shortcuts are intercepted and blocked on canvas
On violation detection, full-screen ban overlay renders immediately with exact ban message
Backend stores banned session/identity; banned users see only ban overlay on return
CSS user-select: none applied to all canvas content

requirements.text: Store ban records in the Motoko backend: a stable data store mapping user principal (Internet Identity) to ban status (boolean) and ban timestamp. Expose query functions to check ban status and update functions to set ban. On app load, check ban status for the authenticated user and show ban overlay if banned.

quotes: Ban status tied to identity forever.

acceptanceCriteria: Backend stores principal → banned mapping in stable storage
setBan(principal) update function marks user as permanently banned
isBanned(principal) query returns ban status
Frontend checks ban status on load and blocks UI for banned users
Ban status persists across canister upgrades

requirements.text: Implement Internet Identity authentication: require users to log in via Internet Identity before they can upload files or trigger generation. Show a login prompt with the dark dragon aesthetic if unauthenticated. After login, display the user's short principal ID in the UI. Use the existing useInternetIdentity hook.

quotes: Internet Identity: Light verification (email/phone) required for uploads. Ban status tied to identity forever.

acceptanceCriteria: Unauthenticated users see a login prompt before accessing upload/generation features
Login uses Internet Identity via useInternetIdentity hook
After login, user principal is displayed in the UI
Upload and generation actions are disabled until authenticated
Ban check runs immediately after authentication

requirements.text: Build a custom emoji picker panel with exactly 15 ForeverRaw Gargoyle Dragon emojis. Each emoji must be a rendered image asset with heavy textured stone/metal/dragon-scale style and red-orange glow. The 15 emojis are: Dragon Eye, Ember, Chain Link, Skull, Raw Heart, Lightning Strike, Stone, Blade, Void, Dragon Shield, Raw Rage, Burning Heart, Prayer, Watching, Steel. The emoji picker should be accessible from a dragon-icon button and allow inserting emojis into any active text input or seed prompt field.

quotes: Custom Emojis: Add emoji picker with these 15 custom ForeverRaw Gargoyle Dragon emojis (heavy textured stone/metal/dragon-scale style with red-orange glow)

acceptanceCriteria: Emoji picker button is accessible from the UI
Picker displays all 15 named ForeverRaw emojis as image assets
Each emoji has a stone/metal dragon-scale visual style with red-orange glow
Clicking an emoji inserts it into the active text/seed input field
Picker closes after selection or on outside click

constraints: All Motoko logic must remain in the single main actor file (backend/main.mo)
Do not edit any files under frontend/src/hooks/ or frontend/src/components/ui
Use the existing useInternetIdentity hook for all authentication
The exact ban message text must be preserved verbatim: 'The Dragon caught you stealing. Account permanently removed. Created by Skulls for the people who wanna stay real.'
Browser-level screenshot prevention is not technically enforceable; implement best-effort JS event blocking only
Red Hat shepherd-main endpoint must be called via HTTP fetch from the frontend; do not proxy through Motoko backend
nonGoals: Real AI model hosting or inference on the Internet Computer canister
Actual steganographic pixel-level watermarking (filename/metadata watermark is sufficient)
Native mobile app or PWA features
Email or SMS verification (Internet Identity is the sole auth method)
Persistent file storage of uploaded user media in the canister
